items.quote: And the glory of the LORD abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
items.claim: Exodus 24:16 says the glory of the LORD rested on Mount Sinai, and a cloud covered the mountain for six days. On the seventh day, the LORD called to Moses from inside the cloud. This is what the text claims, not a confirmed historical event.
items.action: called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud
items.mechanism: divine glory abiding on the mountain; cloud covering for six days; call on the seventh day
